description: Group a set of ACK/NACK, pacs and camt files by shared identifiers (UETR, EndToEndId, TxId) into threads with a timeline and warnings. Case messages (camt.026, camt.027, camt.028, camt.029, camt.056, camt.087, camt.110, camt.111) and Tracker messages (trck.003, trck.005) join the thread of the payment they quote; a camt.111 or trck.005 joins its camt.110 by EIR. Works only on the files given.
name: analyze_payment_lifecycle
title: Analyze payment lifecycle
